relationship_note: Repeated views do not represent additional animals. No cross-publication pooling; source labels preserved.
scale_note: Local printed 1-mm horizontal coordinate arm: endpoints refined to the distal arrow tip and axis origin on the actual source stroke (enlarged review). No inter-panel scale transfer.

rois.label: S
rois.boundary_note: Closed printed field envelope, with internal text retained. Thin geographical surface-projection lines are not used as field borders.
rois.tracing_method: Manually identified source envelope, dense local stroke-center fitting and enlarged visual review

rois.label: V1
rois.boundary_note: Closed V1 perimeter followed over both lateral and reflected medial tissue. Outer tissue cut edges are part of this closed field envelope; thin projected exposed-surface guides inside it are ignored.
rois.tracing_method: source-guided dense contour with visual review

rois.label: V2
rois.boundary_note: Printed curved ribbon traced between the V1 border and its rostral boundary, closing at the visible tissue margin. Short 5-source-pixel continuation where the rostral line approaches the ventral cut; approximate.
rois.tracing_method: source-guided dense contour with visual review
